newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Congress focuses on massive spending bill.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Congress focuses on massive spending bill.

text.p: Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott said Friday Congress will shift its sights to negotiations with the White House on a catch-all spending bill needed to avoid a partial government shutdown at the end of the month rather than keep working on separate money bills.
"We are going to make a serious effort to get a continuing resolution agreed to in Congress by next week. We have got to focus on that. That is a big job," Lott said.
The change of direction would give Congress a better chance of completing its work by the Sept. 30 deadline.
